scope: 13 prepared native scenes/UI pages at 1280x720 and844x390, base resource library vs installed/candidate redraw, paired scene cameras and fixed time/idle. Initial 1-1 also captures actual native pose overrides on first/mid/last action frames. Gallery uses completed in-memory records; all captures avoid user saves. Not a playthrough, browser/pointer test, audio or performance benchmark.
visualAcceptance: Requires manual inspection of original saved pixels, not inferred from successful captures.
